text:
mike: Quick preflight call — planning a green sweep for the RC cutover in ~30m. Please run sanity + flaky-test triage. Do NOT bump version until we confirm green.

ci-bot: Triggered pipeline 7892 for branch: release/rc-2.4. Waiting for agents...

sara: I'll kick off the smoke and core integration suites now, running with --jobs=10. Will report failures as they show up.

kevin: If we see recurring flakes i'll quarantine them and create a short-lived xfail PR on feature/rc-hotfix. Call out any flaky test names.

jen: FYI changelog PR #432 is awaiting one more review. Please avoid merging anything that updates changelog until we finalize bump.

ci-bot: build 7892 started — stage: test/smoke. (logs: https://ci.redwood.example/7892)

ci-bot: build 7892 failed — 3 failing tests: tests/integration/test_cache.py::test_cache_evict (flaky), tests/serving/test_batcher.py::test_batch_timeout (timeout), tests/e2e/test_routing.py::test_fallback (assert). See logs above.

mike: OK, kevin — can you triage test_cache + batcher? If flaky, quarantine; if real, we need a quick fix.

kevin: Looking at logs now. Reproduced test_cache failure locally with seed 42. Suspect race in eviction timing. Going to add a short xfail and open PR.

kevin: Created PR 745 — quarantine tests/integration/test_cache.py with xfail + note. Pushed to feature/rc-hotfix. Commit: abc123.

kevin: Quick command I ran to repro:
```bash
PYTEST_ADDOPTS='-k test_cache_evict -q' pytest tests/integration/test_cache.py::test_cache_evict -s
```

ci-bot: Re-running pipeline for PR 745 -> build 7893 queued.

ci-bot: build 7893 completed — smoke + core integration passed. One timeout remaining in tests/serving/test_batcher.py::test_batch_timeout (flaky).

sara: I'm increasing batcher timeout locally from 2s -> 5s and re-running full suite. If that stabilizes, kevin can follow with a small patch.

jen: About version bump — once we confirm green, I'll open the bump PR (bump to 2.4.1) and ping for changelog approval. Please don't merge changelog before bump PR is up.

olivia: Noted. Cutoff reminder: freeze in 45 minutes from now. If anything blocking remains after final sweep, escalate to oncall and we'll delay.

mike: Thanks. I'll watch the CI and post a final go/no-go ~10m before cutoff.

sara: Extended suite passed after timeout bump. Pushing a patch to feature/rc-hotfix with the timeout tweak: commit def456.

kevin: Merged quarantine PR (745) and timeout tweak PR (746) into feature/rc-hotfix. Triggering green-sweep script against release/rc-2.4.

kevin: Command I used: 
```bash
./scripts/green-sweep.sh --branch release/rc-2.4 --jobs 12 --quarantine-pr 745
```

ci-bot: green-sweep triggered (run id: gs-2026-03-17-01). Running smoke + extended + e2e.

ci-bot: green-sweep completed: all stages passed. Build 7901 succeeded.

mike: Great — final checks: jen, please open bump PR and ping when ready. olivia, hold on release until changelog merged.

jen: Bump PR 750 opened (bump to 2.4.1) and tagged @sara @kevin for review. Changelog PR 432 updated to reference bump and ready to merge after bump PR merges.

olivia: I'll wait for both merged then proceed with canary rollout. Standby for final green confirmation.

mike: Final go from me. :thumbsup: Rolling into cutoff window. Thanks everyone for quick triage.
